findings.claim: An abrupt process exit can orphan Chrome and its temporary profile because library code cannot run its finally block after SIGKILL.
findings.repro: Kill the caller with SIGKILL during an active proof and inspect the process table and working directory. README.md and Known gaps now state this limit.

findings.claim: The deterministic unit suite checks export shape and failed-spawn cleanup. Native protocol behavior remains an integration proof rather than a hermetic unit test.
findings.repro: Run bun test, then compare its assertions with proof/consumer.json and proof/native-host.json.
